content: For all downstream task evaluations, we fine-tune for 10 epochs using LAMB with a learning rate of 0.0002 and batch size of 32. Since our language models are trained with a maximum sequence length of 128 tokens, we do not evaluate on reading comprehension datasets such as SQuAD BIBREF8 or RACE BIBREF9, which require models supporting longer sequences.
